en: A monochrome postcard showing a formally posed portrait of a high‑ranking Qing dynasty woman seated indoors on an ornate throne. She wears elaborate imperial robes with intricate patterns and holds a round fan. Behind her is a richly decorated backdrop with large flowers and drapery. On both sides stand tall pedestals bearing trays piled with fruit and decorative objects; a peacock figure is visible above on the right. Across the upper portion of the image hangs a horizontal Chinese inscription on a scroll.
